items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: Yeah, Dave Perkins is a fellow like me. You never would think that he had colored blood.

ctx.x: Was Dave Perkins very light too? Did you ever play with him? Yeah, Dave Perkins.
He was colored, I guess. Yeah, Dave Perkins is a fellow like me. You never would think that he had colored blood.
Who was that federal player? Who was the violin player? Batiste O'Quinn. Oh yeah, I heard of him from Jack Langan. Oh, you did?
